cards.card_text: He's also against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, “The LORD declares it.” That's the coworker who tacks “the boss said” onto EVERY sentence, even “Copier's jammed.”
cards.verse_text: “Yes,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, ‘The LORD declares it.’”
